brief.t: START HERE: Call Vic at Polo 4PL and obtain the physical location and release status of TR#47618 / EMCU8614105 now.

ACT NOW 1: Polo container TR#47618 / EMCU8614105 had an October 9 pickup appointment, but no later pickup or release confirmation is visible. Polo and PLL are waiting on closure. The appointment was 4 calendar days ago, and the October 12 free-time extension has expired. Send: Vic, please confirm the container's physical location, whether it was picked up and released, and any storage or demurrage now accruing; if it is still at the terminal, send today's recovery appointment.

ACT NOW 2: TALOVA reported a lip balm stockout and requested 500 additional units; delivery of the prior 15,000 units remains unverified. Marcello is waiting. The request is 4 calendar days old with no completion visible. Send: Marcello, I am confirming stock and build timing for the additional 500 and delivery proof for the prior 15,000 now, and I will give you both answers today.

ACT NOW 3: Roon Body asked for production timing for the initial 500 to 600 pieces and the remaining 2,000 pieces after being told the first weekly target may slip. Josh and Sam are waiting. The request is 6 calendar days old with no later production date visible. Send: Josh, I am confirming the current completed quantity and production schedule with the floor this morning, and I will send firm dates for the first 500 to 600 and the remaining 2,000 today.

next: Recommendation: Close Polo first because the free-time extension has expired, then protect the two customer commitments in order: TALOVA and Roon Body.

Roon Body displaced MIXTOPH from Act Now because FedEx shows the material delivered yesterday while Roon still lacks a production commitment for a live job. Physical receipt and COA verification remain scheduled.
Scheduled: 6 operational items. The nearest is NatureInBottle vanilla infused oil shipment 384094781681, expected October 14 between 9:40 AM and 1:40 PM.
Noise: 40 other Outlook messages, none urgent.

Source gaps: CRM and WhatsApp browser sessions are signed out. Purchasing has no current source records to verify supplier, QC, inventory, or lead-time risks. The Email lane was connected and the request routed, but no fresh reply was captured during the run. Missing data is not zero.
signal: Polo container movement remains unverified after free time expired. TALOVA's stockout and 500-unit request are four days old. Roon Body still lacks dates for the first 500 to 600 and remaining 2,000 pieces.
redflags: Polo pickup and release are unverified, and the October 12 free-time extension has expired.
TALOVA's requested 500-unit replenishment and proof of delivery for the prior 15,000 units remain unverified.
Roon Body has no verified production dates for the first 500 to 600 pieces or the remaining 2,000 pieces.
CRM and WhatsApp could not be scanned because both browser sessions are signed out.
noise: 50 inbound Outlook messages arrived during the exact review window; 40 were noise and 10 carried operational, supplier, logistics, or customer context.
